cells.gaps: No coverage fact is dated after June 2023. Clinics: the 2022 yearbook (GNB-010) counts reports, not centres keying their own, and disagrees with the 2018 pilot value (GNB-020), whose tablet entry from health areas has no later fact and no number of sites. Tiers: the 2019 presentation (GNB-017) gave T1;T2;T3 and the 2022 yearbook row speaks of health centres only. Governance: the plan fact (GNB-013, PENSIS 2022-2026) is dated 2022 and is carried because its period covers the as-at; finance is donor on the one row inside the 36 months (GNB-022, the Global Fund through UNDP), and no domestic line is stated. The October 2026 support agreement (GNB-021) is for data quality, dashboards and patient-tracking tools, not a change in where reports are entered.
cells.note: Health centres' monthly reports reach DHIS2 by being keyed from paper at the 11 regional health directorates, which is stage 3's whole row. Stage 4 needs entry at the facility by more than half of primary clinics, and the only facility entry on record is a 2018 pilot of unstated size.
